BiblicalUsage: This is the word for going without food, and it appears once, in the storm that carried Paul's ship toward Malta. After many days of abstinence the men were worn down, and Paul stood up among them to speak.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that fear and hunger had done their work on that ship, and Paul's calm in the middle of it pointed to a God who was still in charge.
